facts.raw_span: multiple asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules over his neck, trunk, and upper limbs
no fever
no lymphadenopathy
discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules measuring 0.5–2 cm in diameter
no overlying erythema, warmth, or tenderness
a single firm, non-tender nodule was palpated on the lateral tongue
vital signs were normal
complete blood count and metabolic profile, were within normal limits
Serologic tests for HIV, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C viruses were nonreactive
no weight loss
no neurologic symptoms
the lesions had slowly increased in size and number

concepts.why: Multiple asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules and a firm, non-tender nodule on the lateral tongue are consistent with neurofibromas.
Discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules without overlying erythema, warmth, or tenderness are consistent with dermatofibromas.
A firm, non-tender nodule on the lateral tongue and multiple asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules are consistent with lipomas.
Discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules without overlying erythema, warmth, or tenderness are consistent with epidermal inclusion cysts.
Multiple asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules and a firm, non-tender nodule on the lateral tongue are consistent with fibromas.
Discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules without overlying erythema, warmth, or tenderness are consistent with pilomatrixomas.
A firm, non-tender nodule on the lateral tongue and multiple asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules are consistent with leiomyomas.
Multiple asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules and a firm, non-tender nodule on the lateral tongue are consistent with schwannomas.

rationales.F01: Multiple asymptomatic skin-colored nodules are common in neurofibroma and dermatofibroma.
rationales.F04: Discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules are characteristic of neurofibroma and fibroma.
rationales.F06: A nodule on the lateral tongue is suggestive of neurofibroma.
rationales.F12: Slowly increasing size and number of lesions is consistent with neurofibroma and fibroma.
